title.quote: SHAPE OF THOUGHT: WHEN DISTRIBUTION MATTERS MORE THAN CORRECTNESS IN REASONING TASKS
title.justification: Title as printed on the first page
title.value: Shape of Thought: When Distribution Matters More than Correctness in Reasoning Tasks

extractions.description: An empirical study of supervised fine-tuning of small LLMs (1.5B-9B, Gemma/Llama/Qwen) on chain-of-thought traces of three kinds: human-written, synthetic with correct final answers (G), and synthetic with incorrect final answers (W). Experiments on MATH, GSM8K, Countdown and MBPP show synthetic traces, even incorrect ones, outperform human-written traces, attributed to distributional closeness; also includes paraphrasing experiments and controlled error-injection experiments.

type.quote: we conduct a systematic study of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reasoning traces across categories (1), (2), and (3) above.
type.justification: The paper runs fine-tuning experiments and reports accuracies.

name.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have made rapid progress on reasoning tasks, often using supervised fine-tuning on chain-of-thought (CoT) traces
name.justification: The paper studies LLM reasoning via SFT.

name.quote: We demonstrate our findings across various reasoning domains like math, algorithmic reasoning and code generation
name.justification: Mathematical reasoning is a setting used and contributed to.

name.quote: We also show our results on code generation using MBPP (Austin et al., 2021) dataset.
name.justification: Code generation is an evaluation venue.

name.quote: This has motivated extensive study of how neural networks learn from noisy labels (Song et al., 2022).
name.justification: Learning from noisy data is background context the paper connects to.

name.quote: Distilling reasoning from synthetic CoT traces enables smaller models to acquire problem-solving ability
name.justification: The paper's method is a distillation/synthetic-data setting.

name.quote: The learning dynamics of neural networks show some similarity to the principles in human cognitive science.
name.justification: Cognitive science is cited as inspiration context.
